relations.statement: A terminalizer that is closed (never unresolved) and rejection-sound is acceptance-complete: every valid proposal is accepted.
If the acceptance bit is allowed and no allowed total decider exists for validity, then acceptance-soundness, rejection-soundness and closure cannot all hold.
relations.hypotheses: allowed (acceptanceBit terminalize) and no allowed total decider for valid

lemmas.statement: Closed two-sided terminalization implies acceptance-completeness, and with an allowed acceptance bit and no allowed total decider, the triple AcceptanceSound, RejectionSound, TerminalClosed is impossible.

near_misses.claim: Acceptance-soundness and rejection-soundness can both hold without closure, by allowing unresolved outcomes.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The impossibility needs TerminalClosed; without it the terminalizer may return unresolved on undecided proposals.
